format: UCWDC Teams participation (future UCWDC body profile)

source.quote_free_summary: Each team member may dance only once in any specific division at each event; a team may enter separate divisions under one Team Name with different songs and choreography but compete once per division; an individual may dance in any team division under any Team Name but not in a division more than once; teams list their competing members when registering.

requirement: A future UCWDC profile must enforce once-per-division per member across Team Names at an event, and require the member list at registration. Studio/Custom enforces no cross-entry member limit.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Future: UCWDC profile, cross-entry member check. The generic Studio/Custom team model (2 to 100 members, no body rules) must not carry it (OD-28 item 9); it belongs to a future body profile.
